path.name: Chainbreaker
path.description: Yayimi liberator who breaks holds and protects comrades.

design.name: Chainbreaker
design.identity: Yayimi liberator who breaks holds and protects comrades.
features: Choose rescuer or breaker. While Raging, once per turn when you hit with a Might-based melee attack, deal extra damage equal to your Rage Damage bonus if the target is Grappling an ally or carrying restraints. As a Bonus Action spend one Freedom use to let an adjacent ally immediately attempt to escape a grapple, using your Might (Athletics) modifier.

While Raging, you have advantage on saves against Paralyzed and Restrained. Rescuer lets an ally within 5 feet use the same advantage; breaker doubles your weapon damage against nonmagical restraints and unattended doors.
As an Action spend one Freedom use: up to three allies within 30 feet who hear you gain temporary Health equal to 1d8 + Resolve modifier. They can stand from Prone without spending movement.
Once per Long Rest as a Reaction when an ally within 30 feet fails a save against Charmed, Frightened or Restrained, let it succeed instead. You must be Raging and able to see the ally.

features.completionRules: The ally's escape check uses the source grapple DC and your full Might/Athletics modifier; no ally action is spent. Rescuer at level 6 benefits all willing allies within 5 feet while you Rage. Rally grants max(0,1d8+Resolve modifier) temporary Health to each selected target.
